environment.description: Same Celery worker deployment on ECS Fargate behind API Gateway (HTTP API type) with a request model validator attached to the POST /exports route. The model schema enforces: job_id must match regex ^[a-f0-9\-]{36}$ (UUID v4), export_path must be one of enum ['/tmp', '/var/exports', '/data/exports'] (no freeform string), privilege_level must be absent or exactly 'standard' (admin disallowed in schema), and callback_url if present must match ^https://[a-z0-9\-]+\.internal\.corp/. The validator is configured with validateRequestBody: true and the integration returns 400 before reaching the backend if schema validation fails. Additionally, the Fargate task definition sets readonlyRootFilesystem: true with only /tmp mounted as ephemeral storage, and the container runs with a custom seccomp profile that blocks kill(2) and tgkill(2) syscalls from non-init processes within the container (preventing external signal injection). The ECS service uses awsvpc networking with a security group allowing inbound only from the API Gateway VPC endpoint.
